bio.text: Edward Codelia is a nonpartisan candidate for Hawaii's 2nd Congressional District in the 2026 general election, according to Honolulu Civil Beat.
In Civil Beat's candidate survey, Codelia lists Pukalani as a residence and says Codelia moved to Hawaii in early adulthood and has lived on Maui for more than 35 years.

sources.title: Candidate Q&A: US House District 2 - Edward Codelia
